content: Linguistic Embeddings. It is both easy and effective to incorporate linguistic embeddings into the input layer of MRC models. For example, BIBREF24 and BIBREF19 used POS embeddings and NER embeddings to construct their input embeddings; BIBREF25 used structural embeddings based on parsing trees to constructed their input embeddings.
